nodes.label: Brand Design System
nodes.summary: Visual identity spec: Space Grotesk + Inter, Hearth gold #FACC15, Midnight #0A0D16, gradient orbs, power4.out easing.

nodes.label: No Random in Timeline
nodes.summary: No Math.random() or Date.now() in GSAP timelines; use seeded PRNG only for determinism.

nodes.label: No CDN Dependencies
nodes.summary: GSAP source must come from config.json gsap_source, not CDN links, so one change affects all renders.

nodes.label: power4.out Easing Required
nodes.summary: Entrance animations must use power4.out/expo.out; default linear easing is forbidden.

nodes.label: brand-kit/DESIGN.md
nodes.summary: Brand design system spec: color palette, typography, layout safe zones, component sizing, animation standards.

nodes.label: Space Grotesk (headings)
nodes.summary: Display typeface used for headings, badges, and chapter labels.

nodes.label: Inter (body)
nodes.summary: Body typeface used for narration body text and caption bar text.
